text: After [a police trap for the serial killer stalking her|trigger|a sudden accident or attack] leaves her with amnesia, Los Angeles news anchor Karen White is sent with her husband Bill to the Colony, a secluded countryside resort full of strange characters. Howling fills the nights, Bill is [bitten on the arm by a wolf|rules|it passes to others], and [he slips away to meet the sultry Marsha|who_suffers|spouses and lovers] by a campfire, where [they change in the moonlight|threat|the body turning monstrous]. Meanwhile Karen's friend Terry learns the killer's body has vanished from the morgue.
